text: {"features":[{"name":"Tailored motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this specific role at Google rather than making a generic application.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a generic application with little personal reason for this role, this team, or Google beyond broad interest in software or security."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows sincere interest in security or backend work but gives only limited personalization to Google's Information Security Engineering context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, role-relevant reason for applying and connects the opportunity to the applicant's interests at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a convincing, role-specific motivation rooted in the applicant's experience, beliefs, or prior exposure to the kinds of problems this team solves."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Threads the letter with memorable, personal motivation that makes this role feel like an intentional next step uniquely suited to the applicant's goals and values."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How clearly the letter shows understanding of the actual work in this job, including security automation, vulnerability handling, agentic tooling, and development-lifecycle integration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes the role only in generic backend or security terms without showing awareness of the team's concrete responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows partial understanding by naming one relevant area, such as security automation or AI, but not how the responsibilities fit together."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows good understanding of several core responsibilities, such as tool building, vulnerability handling, back-end implementation, or supporting developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong job insight by connecting multiple responsibilities such as automation, agents, triage, lifecycle integration, scale, and collaboration with security specialists."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced, role-specific insight into how automated tooling, AI agents, vulnerability workflows, and organization-wide security leverage fit together in this exact job."}]},{"name":"Security enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping developers do the secure thing by default rather than adding friction or acting only as compliance review.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security mainly as isolated review, defense, or compliance work and does not present a developer-enablement perspective."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping others or reducing effort but does not clearly connect security to developer workflow or secure defaults."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear desire to reduce manual security work or help engineers adopt safer practices through better tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates security as enablement, emphasizing reduced friction, secure defaults, or partnership with product and developer teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a mature philosophy of embedding security into everyday development so the secure path becomes the easy path at scale."}]},{"name":"Infrastructure mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys fit for foundational backend and reliability-sensitive engineering rather than generic product development.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames interests in broad software terms and does not show a preference for foundational, backend, or reliability-critical work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at infrastructure interest but mainly speaks in general security or software language without much emphasis on foundational systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses clear interest in backend or platform systems and some appreciation for reliability, shared tooling, or scale."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Strongly aligns with foundational engineering, emphasizing dependable systems, platform impact, quiet resilience, or the value of serving many teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes infrastructure leverage and reliability discipline a core professional identity, so the role reads as a natural extension of how the applicant already chooses problems."}]},{"name":"Software engineering experience","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is for relevant professional software engineering experience in testing, maintaining, and launching production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only early-career production experience, typically around three years with a small number of launched services and little sense of scope or ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a modest but credible production record, such as a few years with several services or somewhat longer experience described in narrow terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid professional experience, typically around five years with clear responsibility for maintaining and launching production systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents strong relevant experience, typically five to seven years with multiple production services and signs of ownership, breadth, or repeated delivery."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents especially seasoned experience, typically around seven years with repeated launches and stewardship of several production systems in a way that reads as highly job-ready."}]},{"name":"Go backend fit","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant experience building back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly as one language among many and gives no meaningful evidence of backend depth in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a working language but offers little evidence of substantial production use or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a regular production language used for services or backend work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes Go clearly primary and connects it to designing or implementing production backend systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to the applicant's fit for the role, with clear ownership of substantial backend systems or Go services that anchor broader security tooling."}]},{"name":"Python automation fit","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant Python experience for automation, tooling, analysis, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it only as a name without any usable context."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly but gives little evidence of production use for tooling, services, or automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for services, scripts, data pipelines, or internal tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience in automation, analysis, service prototypes, or tooling used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major strength with concrete ownership of automation layers, internal services, or agent frameworks central to the role."}]},{"name":"AI systems fit","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant experience building, shipping, and evaluating AI or LLM-backed functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of hands-on AI or model-based work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals general AI interest or gives a vague mention of model work without showing delivery or responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on AI or LLM work in production with at least one concrete example of shipping functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus attention to evaluation, reliability, hardening, safeguards, or trustworthiness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial AI experience tightly connected to dependable systems, explaining how model behavior was constrained, evaluated, or made safe enough for real use."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems fit","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing autonomous or agent-based systems similar to the role's Python AI agents and supporting infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of designing agentic systems or bounded multi-step automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation in general but does not describe agents, autonomy, or architectural boundaries."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes designing agents or multi-step autonomous workflows at a high level without much operational detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains an agentic architecture with Python agents and coordinating Go infrastructure, auditable actions, or explicit constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong design ownership of agentic systems, emphasizing bounded tasks, contracts, supervision, logging, or guardrails in a way that maps directly to this role."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability response automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of work on vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security automation in broad terms without a concrete vulnerability workflow or outcome."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes automating some part of vulnerability report intake, classification, routing, or queue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful ownership of a vulnerability triage pipeline that reduced manual work through classification, deduplication, routing, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents strong end-to-end experience automating vulnerability response at system level, with clear impact on workload and strong alignment to triage or variant-analysis style work."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on experience performing security assessments such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or fix validation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes only a vague security claim without naming methods, scope, or hands-on assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions conducting security assessments such as threat modeling or code review in a credible but limited way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete hands-on assessment experience with specific methods like attack-surface mapping, validating fixes, or reviewing existing systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys mature assessment practice with multiple methods and an attacker's perspective, showing the applicant can do more than checklist-style review."}]},{"name":"Algorithms strength","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of meaningful data-structure or algorithmic work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength in generic terms without a concrete example of applying it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes one concrete example of using better structures or algorithms to improve performance, tractability, or correctness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clearly substantial algorithmic thinking in production, such as redesigning scheduling, graph traversal, indexing, matching, or another core system path."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic strength a standout asset with concrete examples that materially changed tractability, performance, or correctness in complex systems."}]},{"name":"Offensive security engagement","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates attacker-oriented practice through CTF participation, security certifications, or other externally grounded offensive learning.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of offensive-security practice, certification, or attacker-oriented skill building."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a basic security credential or occasional attacker-oriented practice with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing attacker-oriented learning through recurring CTF participation or comparable practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Combines regular offensive practice with strong results or a demanding hands-on certification such as OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates unusually strong attacker-oriented credibility through top competitive results, OSCP-level validation, or both, and ties that experience back to engineering judgment."}]},{"name":"Self-directed technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates engineering initiative beyond assigned work through open-source maintenance, upstream fixes, or substantial side projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of technical initiative outside ordinary job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or occasional patching with limited scope, depth, or sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows consistent initiative through useful side projects, occasional open-source contributions, or self-driven technical experimentation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial initiative through maintaining an open-source project or building a serious side system with nontrivial engineering challenges."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows standout self-directed engineering depth, such as active maintainership of widely used tooling or a substantial independently built distributed system sustained over time."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter backs its claims with concrete, observable examples rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims, adjectives, or résumé-like assertions with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few facts such as years, languages, or titles but gives limited detailed evidence for key claims."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports major claims with at least some concrete examples of projects, responsibilities, methods, or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly backs claims with specific, relevant examples that make the applicant's strengths easy to verify from the letter alone."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses concrete, role-relevant evidence for nearly every major claim, packing the letter with crisp examples or outcomes without becoming a list."}]},{"name":"Narrative effectiveness","description":"How well the letter turns the applicant's background into a coherent and persuasive case for fit, rather than merely listing qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels like an unconnected list of facts and does not build a clear argument for fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has some structure but moves mechanically between points or leaves the central case underdeveloped."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Forms a coherent case for fit, linking background to the role in a mostly orderly and persuasive way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well-shaped and persuasive, with a clear throughline connecting motivation, experience, and role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Reads as a highly effective cover letter rather than a résumé in prose, creating a distinctive and coherent argument for why this applicant should be interviewed."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How polished, accurate, and professionally readable the prose is, including spelling, grammar, and sentence-level fluency.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that distract from the application or undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has several noticeable errors or awkward constructions but remains understandable overall."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and professional with only minor errors or rough spots."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean, fluent, and easy to read, with strong sentence control and no meaningful distractions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished and readable, combining flawless mechanics with professional phrasing that strengthens credibility."}]}]}
